name: Mental Disorders: Followers of Khorne
description: Black Crusade, Table 8-8 (p. 279). Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Blind Hatred
results.text: The character fixates on one chosen enemy. While it is on the field, he must pass a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test to fight any other foe.

results.name: Frenzy
results.text: In combat the character must pass a Hard (-10) Willpower Test or attack whatever is nearest, allies and objects included.

results.name: Blood Soaked
results.text: Must indulge once a week. Otherwise -5 to Skill Tests requiring concentration, worsening by a further -5 each week to a maximum of -20.

results.name: Abstemious
results.text: -10 to all Interaction Tests when dealing with those who do not share his martial focus.
